name: Java Interview Questions for Freshers
title: Java Interview Questions for Freshers
description: Practice these 146 Java MCQs with detailed explanations and prepare yourself for fresher interviews in Java.

modules.name: Java basics (data types, variables, operators)
modules.description: Fundamental building blocks of Java programming. Covers how data is stored, manipulated, and the basic operations that can be performed.

modules.name: Control flow statements
modules.description: Structures that control the flow of program execution. Includes decision-making and looping constructs essential for creating logic in programs.

modules.name: Arrays and collections
modules.description: Data structures for storing multiple elements. Discusses both simple arrays and the more flexible Collection framework for managing groups of objects.

modules.name: String manipulation and String pool
modules.description: Techniques for manipulating text data. Explores the String class, its methods, and the concept of the String pool for efficient memory usage.

modules.name: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts
modules.description: Core principles of object-oriented programming. Covers the basic concepts that allow for creating modular, reusable code through objects and classes.

modules.name: Inheritance and interfaces
modules.description: Mechanisms for code reuse and abstraction. Discusses how classes can inherit properties and methods, and how interfaces define contracts for classes.

modules.name: Encapsulation and polymorphism
modules.description: Principles for hiding internal details and supporting multiple forms. Covers data protection and the ability of objects to take on multiple forms.

modules.name: Exception handling
modules.description: Techniques for handling and managing errors. Explores how to gracefully handle unexpected situations in code to prevent crashes and improve reliability.

modules.name: Abstract classes and methods
modules.description: Tools for creating base templates and contracts. Discusses partially implemented classes and methods that enforce certain structures in child classes.

modules.name: Java I/O and file handling
modules.description: Methods for reading from and writing to external sources. Covers techniques for interacting with files and handling input/output operations.

modules.name: Generics
modules.description: Mechanism for creating reusable, type-safe code. Explores how to write methods and classes that can work with different data types while maintaining type safety.

modules.name: Java memory management and garbage collection
modules.description: Automatic memory handling in Java. Discusses how Java manages object lifecycles and automatically frees up unused memory.

submodules.name: Java memory management and garbage collection

modules.name: Multithreading and concurrency
modules.description: Techniques for executing multiple tasks simultaneously. Covers creating and managing threads, as well as synchronizing access to shared resources.

modules.name: Lambda expressions and functional interfaces
modules.description: Compact syntax for passing behaviors as method arguments. Explores functional programming concepts in Java for more concise and expressive code.

modules.name: Java 8+ features (Stream API, Optional class)
modules.description: Modern Java language features. Covers newer additions to Java that enhance productivity and provide more powerful ways to process data.

prerequisite_details.title: Learn Java
